purpose: Compile a bounded repair procedure from verified train traces, execute it on source-separated held-out fixtures, verify independently, and publish/reject through the existing manifest registry. This is a procedure baseline, not a neural policy or model-selected action.

acceptance.accept_if: dev and all held-out cases pass the independent evaluator; non-target constants preserved
acceptance.reject_if: any held-out failure or harmful candidate
acceptance.publication: ManifestRegistry atomic active pointer; no neural weights

retention: Keep raw procedure receipts, case results, active manifest and rejection evidence. No model or base checkpoint is saved.
claims: Procedure-library improvement only; no neural candidate, model-selected action or personal fidelity claim.
